metadata.title: Triple kill where Valorant said ‘Hold my spike, this should NOT work’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just luck-snipe three enemies?
My brain checked out but kills kept stacking.
Click if your aim’s lazy but results speak louder!

Tap in if your best plays are pure accident chaos!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
